projects.name: ROS--2-Ten-Months-Challenge
projects.title: 🤖 ROS 2 Ten Months Challenge
projects.description: Contains Robotics projects and resources from March 15 to December 15 2025
projects.readme:
A long-term ROS 2 robotics challenge documenting my progression from ROS 2 fundamentals and micro-ROS to AI perception, stereo vision, SLAM, and autonomous robotics using the XRP platform.

This repository is a **collection of practical ROS 2 projects**. Each project lives in its own folder under `projects/` with its own README, firmware, and ROS 2 workspace, so it can be read, built, and run independently.
highlights: This is an ongoing project under the Hardware Innovation Valley Community.
ROS 2 Jazzy — installation guide
micro-ROS Agent — first application tutorial
PlatformIO (VS Code extension or CLI) for building microcontroller firmware
colcon, rosdep, and a working ~/ros2ws build setup
micro-ROS transport working over Wi-Fi (UDP)

highlights: 📷 100% Passive & Camera-Free: Zero optical cameras or audio microphones. Respects user privacy while maintaining spatial awareness.
🧱 Wall-Penetrating Motion Detection: Uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi CSI signal distortion to sense movement behind solid walls.
⚡ Battery & Solar Powered: Low-power architecture with TP4056 Type-C charging and an 80x40mm 5V solar panel.
🐱 Cyberpunk Cat Enclosure: Compact, cute, 3D-printable cat-themed handheld chassis designed in Autodesk Fusion 360.
Frame Inspection: Intercepts 0xC0 (Deauthentication) and 0xA0 (Disassociation) frames.
Distance Estimation: Calculates physical attacker proximity using Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI).
